description: This file defines the VLookup class which implements the VLOOKUP function used in spreadsheet calculations. It provides methods to perform lookup operations within a table, including handling exact and approximate matches.

classes.name: VLookup
classes.description: A class encapsulating the VLOOKUP spreadsheet function, enabling value lookup in a table with options for exact or approximate matching.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs a VLOOKUP operation to find a value in the left-most column of lookup_array and returns a corresponding value from the specified column based on the index number. Supports array arguments and handles both exact and approximate matches.

methods.name: vlookupSort
methods.description: A helper method for sorting lookup array rows based on the first column, used when not performing an exact match.

methods.name: vLookupSearch
methods.description: Searches for the lookup value within the lookup array, returning the row number where a match is found, considering the match type.
